label: PHASE_O_TRAJECTORY_V2_DECISION_V1
rationale: Phase O prerequisite: acquisition must be adequate. Phase I showed acquisition fails at 360p: motion-coherent selection fails because diver displacement (~14% frame height) is insufficient to distinguish from bystanders. Flight-arc geometry fails because the arc subtends too few pixels for reliable segmentation. Human-centric trajectory V2 cannot be built on failed acquisition.
